title: Stardust Meadows Server
description: This is the official Modpack of the Stardust Meadows Server!
body:
**Hi! Thank you for checking out the Stardust Meadows Server Modpack!!** 

We are officially Live!! We hope to see you on soon!! 

This is a whitelisted server and the only way to get access to get on the server is by joining our discord! You can find the link [here](https://discord.gg/EpWseH7SU)! Please follow the instructions on how to join channel of the discord to get access to the server!!

We are a chill server that plays with Keep Inventory on, and there is no pressure to be totally active all time! We know everyone has their own schedules to deal with, just looking at building an amazing world and make some new friends! 

I hope you will join us in creating an awesome world!! Happy Crafting!!
